name: Mimic, Miniaturizing
body:
Miniaturizing Mimic
CR 3

This innocuous music box plays an enchanting melody of its own accord before snapping at the hand that reaches for it.

XP 800
N Tiny aberration (shapechanger)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7
Aura diminishment (DC 14)

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +4 natural, +2 size)
hp 22 (4d8+4)
Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +4
Immune acid, bardic masterpieces and performances, language-dependent effects, sonic

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee bite +6 (1d3-1 plus curse of diminishment and grab)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks bardic performance 6 rounds/day (countersong, distraction, fascinate [DC 14]), diminishing swallow whole (1d3-1 bludgeoning plus 1d6 acid damage, AC 12, hp 18)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 4th; concentration +6)

At will—ghost sound (DC 12)
1/day—hold person (DC 14), suggestion (DC 14)

TACTICS

Before Combat The minuscule mimic uses ghost sound (if imitating a music box) or suggestion to entice creatures to pick it up.

During Combat The minuscule mimic attempts to shrink opponents with its diminishment ability, then swallow them whole for later digestion.

Morale The minuscule mimic attempts to flee if it is in danger of being captured or if its enemies seem resistant to its curse.

STATISTICS

Str 9, Dex 15, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 11, Cha 14
Base Atk +2; CMB +2 (+6 grapple); CMD 10
Feats Agile Maneuvers, Weapon Finesse
Skills Climb +9, Disguise +9 (+29 when mimicking objects), Perception +7, Stealth +17; Racial Modifiers +20 Disguise when mimicking objects
Languages Common
SQ mimic object

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura of Diminishment (Su)

Miniaturizing mimics unleash a mesmerizing melody that causes creatures who hear them to shrink in size. Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of a miniaturizing mimic is affected by its curse of diminishment (see below) unless it succeeds on a DC 14 Will save. This aura is a sonic mind-affecting effect, and the miniaturizing mimic can activate or suppress its aura at will as a move action.

Curse of Diminishment (Su)

Bite—contact; save Fort DC 14, frequency 1/round; effect Target becomes a Microsized creature and is reduced in size by 1d4 size categories, to a minimum size of Fine. Multiple failed saves stack this size reduction, to a minimum size of Fine. The target’s weapons, armor, and gear that it wields or carries is similarly reduced in size. The save DC is Charisma-based. If a cursed target is subjected to the curse of diminishment again and fails its saving throw, it immediately reduces in size by one additional size category. Removing the curse stops the target from shrinking further, but it doesn’t return them to their true size. Once the curse has been removed, the creature can attempt a new DC 14 Fortitude save each day to regrow one size category. Once the creature has been returned to its normal size, it is no longer a Microsized creature.

Mimic Object (Ex)

A miniaturizing mimic can assume the general shape of any Tiny object, such as a jewelry box, a music box, or a figurine. The creature cannot substantially alter its size, though. A minuscule mimic’s body is hard and has a rough texture, no matter what appearance it might present. A mimic gains a +20 racial bonus on Disguise checks when imitating an object in this manner. Disguise is always a class skill for a minuscule mimic.

ECOLOGY

Environment any urban
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

Often assuming the form of small jewelry or music boxes, a miniaturizing mimic possesses the unique ability to shrink creatures using strange gases that they expel from their bodies during strange, mesmerizing melodies. Miniaturizing mimics use this unique power to lure unsuspecting prey to them before diminishing them to near powerlessness and gobbling them up.
